title: Calling the Earth's Veins
summary: A rite that persuades buried material to rise.
pages: The earth can be asked to surrender what it keeps beneath stone. Dirt, egg, Milk of the Mother, and a token of the desired ore form the language of the request.
A pickaxe becomes the catalyst. The amount offered determines how much the earth may return; skulls, crystals, and candles can alter the work at additional cost.
